hensoldt-ag.method: BOHUN B4CE reference card (10 sections, evidence per claim)

about.workspace: HENSOLDT AG is the parent company of the HENSOLDT Group, a German provider of electronic sensor solutions for defence and security. The group develops and manufactures air defence and naval radars (TRML-4D, SPEXER), IFF systems, electronic warfare and self-protection systems, avionics and optronics, and is design authority for the Eurofighter ECRS Mk1 radar. Products are made by group subsidiaries such as HENSOLDT Sensors GmbH. The group also has civil lines: air traffic control radar and precision optics for semiconductor lithography.
about.overview: Parent company of the HENSOLDT Group: air defence and naval radars, IFF, electronic warfare, avionics and optronics for armed and security forces. Design authority for the Eurofighter ECRS Mk1 radar. Civil lines include air traffic control radar and lithography optics. About two thirds of 2025 revenue came from Germany.

about.workspace: Exail Technologies is the listed holding company of a French group specialised in autonomous robotics and inertial navigation. The listed legal entity itself has 3–5 employees; operations sit in subsidiaries. Through the Belgium Naval & Robotics consortium with Naval Group, Exail supplies the drone mission system for twelve Belgian and Dutch mine countermeasure vessels. The group says most of its revenue comes from defence; 2025 revenue grew around 28%.
